intermediate.title: Sprint | 3rd passage of the finish line (182.2 km)

story: A six-rider breakaway formed early but was caught with 40 km remaining. Continuous attacks followed in the peloton. With 15 km to go, L’Hôte went clear before a group of five joined him. In the uphill sprint, Kamp took victory ahead of Bessega and Thomas.
